messages.subject: Prepping the dataset
messages.body_plain:
Hi colleagues,

I am new to IsoriX and I am hoping to be able to use it for my masters project, though I am not sure if my data is suitable. A background to my project is that I am trying to assign the migratory origin of breeding turtles using tissue isotopes, first by building an isoscape based on the turtle skin carbon isotope signatures of turtles from known locations. It is a simple dataset with 4 columns (turtle_ID, lat, long, dC13). As it does not contain all the columns listed in the bookdown, does this mean I am unable to use this package or can things be modified?

Many thanks in advance,
Sofia
